# Adam Pugh

> I am a Senior Documentation Engineer who makes complex product documentation and knowledge systems easier to use, govern, and maintain.

## Professional profile

- Experience: I have more than 20 years of technical writing and documentation experience, including about 13 years of direct people management.
- Focus: I work in product documentation, information architecture, content governance, migrations, documentation analytics, structured authoring, and workflow tooling.
- Leadership: I previously worked as a Documentation Engineering Manager and Senior Manager of Technical Writing. I led a team of four and a 16-person documentation organization.
- Education: I earned a B.A. in Journalism with a Minor in Communications from the University of Arizona in 2003.
- Current independent work: I have owned and operated Vinyl Junction since 2014.

## Selected evidence

- [Euler documentation proposal](https://adamthepugh.com/docs/case-studies/euler-documentation-prototype/): I built an independent prototype from Euler’s public material to demonstrate a clearer documentation model.
- [TeraCreators Help](https://adamthepugh.com/docs/case-studies/teracreators-help/): I published community documentation for five games, with a public guide and source repository.
- [Migrations and information architecture](https://adamthepugh.com/docs/case-studies/migrations-and-ia/): I led a four-person team that completed 101 content migrations across seven team groups and consolidated 1,157 source pages into 469 destination pages.
- [Analytics and reporting](https://adamthepugh.com/docs/case-studies/analytics-and-reporting/): I created seven automated Tableau dashboards that received 735 views from 39 active users and supported 11 operations reviews per month.
- [Documentation tooling and automation](https://adamthepugh.com/docs/case-studies/documentation-tooling-and-automation/): I built 10 internal documentation and workflow tools with more than 750 automated tests. The broader program was estimated to save 466 hours per year.
